topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the opening framing, outline, and learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian clonal selection driven by sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell-of-origin models in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how stem cell properties, hierarchical organization, and the specific cell of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external environmental factors, inflammation, and supportive stroma promote tumorigenesis and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Experimental and computational tools for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It addresses the technological and methodological approaches used to analyze tumor evolution, cell plasticity, and spatial cellular interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin characteristics, and microenvironmental conditions converge to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and upcoming lecture preview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the concluding administrative framing and previews the topic of the next lecture.
